class.name: E3DMesh
class.brief_description: The triangle surface of an E3D submodel, its arrays kept in memory.
class.description: An [ArrayMesh] keeps its data only in the [RenderingServer]: saving it, or reading its faces or arrays, reads every buffer back from the GPU. [E3DMesh] keeps the arrays of its one surface as floats beside the [RenderingServer] mesh made of them, so the model is saved on the thread that loaded it and [method Mesh.get_faces], [method Mesh.surface_get_arrays] and [method Mesh.get_aabb] read no GPU.

members.member: The surface's arrays: [code]vertices[/code], [code]normals[/code], [code]tangents[/code] (optional) and [code]uvs[/code] as [PackedFloat32Array], [code]indices[/code] as [PackedInt32Array] of clockwise triangles. Setting it makes the [RenderingServer] mesh of them on the calling thread.
